back: Favor double over float unless space is at a premium, as the lack of precision in a float will often lead to inaccuracies.
front: Is it best practice to favor a double or a float? Why?
source_suffix: Rounding errors make floating point comparisons trickyFloating point numbers are tricky to work with due to non-obvious differences between binary (how data is stored) and decimal (how we think) numbers. Consider the fraction 1/10. In decimal, this is easily represented as 0.1, and we are used to thinking of 0.1 as an easily representable number with 1 significant digit.
